lines.line: 500g/ 1 lb pork mince / ground pork (or chicken or turkey)
1 tbsp (tightly packed) brown sugar (or 1 1/2 tbsp honey)
3 tbsp hoisin sauce (avoid orange hoisin eg. Ayam, Note 1)
Pinch white pepper (, or black pepper)
1/8 tsp red food colouring (, optional (for touch of Chinese BBQ Pork colour!))
Green onion (, finely sliced, and/or white sesame seeds)
Fresh veggies for the side - cucumber slices (, tomato, grated carrot, steamed broccoli)
